name: MonarchAiEditProposal
title: AiEditProposal
wrapsNative: VStack card with Text(AttributedString) word diffs, MonarchButton, MonarchBadge, MonarchAiGeneratedBadge, MonarchFlowLayout, @AccessibilityFocusState, AccessibilityNotification.Announcement
summary: A reviewable diff of edits an AI proposes to a document or record, accepted or rejected per change or all at once, and revertible once applied.
whenToUse: When an assistant proposes changes to text or fields the person owns, so nothing is applied until they decide.
whenNotToUse: For comparing two versions without decisions use MonarchDiffViewer. For a single suggested value in a form field use MonarchAiAutofillField.
api: init(_ part: MonarchAiEditProposalPart, hunks: [MonarchAiEditHunk], title: String? = nil, labels: MonarchAiEditProposalLabels = MonarchAiEditProposalLabels(), onAcceptAll: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onRejectAll: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onAcceptHunk: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onRejectHunk: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onRevert: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
struct MonarchAiEditHunk: Identifiable { var id, before, after: String; var label: String?; var status: MonarchAiEditHunkStatus? }
enum MonarchAiEditHunkStatus: String { case proposed, accepted, rejected }
enum MonarchAiEditProposalEvent { case accepted, rejected, acceptedAll, rejectedAll }

struct MonarchAiEditProposalLabels { var badge: String?; var state: (@Sendable (MonarchAiEditProposalState) -> String)?; var hunkState: (@Sendable (MonarchAiEditHunkStatus) -> String)?; var count: (@Sendable (Int, Int) -> String)?; var hunkName: (@Sendable (Int, Int) -> String)?; var acceptAll, rejectAll, accept, reject, revert, deleted, inserted, unchanged: String?; var announcement: (@Sendable (MonarchAiEditProposalEvent, Int) -> String)?; var readOnly: (@Sendable (MonarchAiEditProposalState) -> String)? }

options.name: part
options.description: The edit-proposal part of the message. Its state decides whether the edits can change; its id scopes remembered decisions.

options.name: hunks
options.description: The changes in document order, each with the text before and after.

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces "Suggested edits"; also names the card for VoiceOver.

options.name: onAcceptAll
options.description: Accepts every undecided change; shows Accept all while proposed.

options.name: onRejectAll
options.description: Rejects every undecided change; shows Reject all while proposed.

options.name: onAcceptHunk
options.description: Accepts one change by id; shows Accept on each undecided change.

options.name: onRejectHunk
options.description: Rejects one change by id; shows Reject on each undecided change.

options.name: onRevert
options.description: Undoes applied edits; shows Revert once the part is applied.

states.name: proposed
states.description: Info state badge, the count of changes left, per-change and all buttons.

states.name: change accepted
states.description: A success check and "Accepted"; the removed text is muted and the added text plain, still underlined.

states.name: change rejected
states.description: A muted cross and "Rejected"; the original text is plain and the proposed text muted.

states.name: applied
states.description: Success badge, "These edits were applied.", every change accepted unless rejected, and Revert.

states.name: rejected
states.description: Neutral badge and every change rejected; no buttons.

states.name: reverted
states.description: Warning badge; every change shows undecided because nothing of it is in the document.

states.name: no change
states.description: A change whose text is the same shows it with "(No change)".

appearance: A card on the surface with the default border and an AI border bar on the leading edge. Each change sits on the subtle background with a subtle border. Removed words use the AI diff remove fill and strong colour with a strikethrough; added words the AI diff add fill and strong colour with an underline. All roles come from the theme.
platformNotes: The web takes title as a node; here it is a String. The web's word tokens keep inner apostrophes as one word; this component reuses MonarchDiffViewer's tokens, which split them, so a changed contraction can show a smaller change. Focus moves with VoiceOver's accessibility focus instead of keyboard focus. The web's polite live region is an accessibility announcement. The part keeps the conversation model's MonarchAiEditProposalPart.
accessibility: The card is a container named by its title; the title is a header.
Each change is one element read as its name, its decision, then the diff with "Deleted:" and "Inserted:" before removed and added words.
Per-change buttons are named with the change, for example "Accept, Change 2 of 3".
After a decision the result is announced ("Change accepted. 2 left.") and VoiceOver focus moves to the next undecided change's Accept button, else the title.
Removed text is struck through and added text underlined, and decisions have an icon and a word, so nothing depends on colour.
Buttons have 44-point touch targets; text scales with Dynamic Type and wraps.
edgeCases: Decisions are remembered per part id: a regenerated proposal with a new id starts undecided even if it reuses change ids.
A change's own status wins over a remembered decision.
Accept all and Reject all only decide undecided changes and hide when none are left.
An addition has an empty before; a removal an empty after.
Very long texts fall back to one removal and one insertion above two million word pairs.

examples.title: Review and apply
examples.template:
MonarchAiEditProposal(
    MonarchAiEditProposalPart(id: "edit-1", target: "doc-1", diff: .null),
    hunks: [
        MonarchAiEditHunk(id: {{hunks.0.id}}, before: {{hunks.0.before}}, after: {{hunks.0.after}}, label: {{hunks.0.label}}),
        MonarchAiEditHunk(id: {{hunks.1.id}}, before: {{hunks.1.before}}, after: {{hunks.1.after}}, label: {{hunks.1.label}}),
        MonarchAiEditHunk(id: {{hunks.2.id}}, before: {{hunks.2.before}}, after: {{hunks.2.after}}, label: {{hunks.2.label}}),
    ],
    onAcceptAll: {},
    onRejectAll: {},
    onAcceptHunk: { _ in },
    onRejectHunk: { _ in }
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiEditProposal(
    MonarchAiEditProposalPart(id: "edit-1", target: "doc-1", diff: .null),
    hunks: [
        MonarchAiEditHunk(id: "title", before: "Quarterly plan", after: "Quarterly roadmap", label: "Title"),
        MonarchAiEditHunk(id: "summary", before: "The team will ship the new onboarding flow in May.", after: "The team will ship the redesigned onboarding flow in early June.", label: "Summary"),
        MonarchAiEditHunk(id: "owner", before: "Sam", after: "Sam Lee", label: "Owner"),
    ],
    onAcceptAll: {},
    onRejectAll: {},
    onAcceptHunk: { _ in },
    onRejectHunk: { _ in }
)
